message: Hi Alex, it's Aisha at Pearl Dentistry, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Aisha, honest answer: I used AI to help draft and research it, then reviewed and sent it myself. I do the same for site audits—AI speeds up the first pass, I check the work. I'm Alex, I run Northlight Web, fixing website issues (not apps or ads). Happy to show you what I found on your site if you want a quick look.
